question: Do actual R=Z[sqrt(-2)]-linear mod4 lifts of the three retained Q602 mod2 residues refine their action on the 16-point invariant polarization kernel A[2], and can that action be matched to the isotropic Prym glue more sharply than EX1-05Z?

parent_05z.exact_use: 05Z correctly identifies the isotropic cover, A[2] as a 16-point 2-primary polarization kernel, and the mod4 coordinate model. Its arbitrary Z/4-linear insufficiency witness is re-audited here inside the actual R-linear endomorphism ring.

principal_rosati.exact_use: The integral basis is (e1,e2,r*e1,r*e2), r^2=-2, with the exact principal Riemann form and Rosati involution.

d4d4_trace.exact_use: The exact eight-coordinate quadratic form Q and unimodular isometry to D4 direct-sum D4 are used to prove exact Q=602 realizability of every retained mod4 class without materializing the 1.3-billion shell.

exact_W.exact_use: W has basis r*e1,r*e2 and the retained exact-W plus transvection pipeline leaves mod2 residues 73,97,235.

borowka_ortega.title: Klein coverings of genus 2 curves
borowka_ortega.exact_use: In the isotropic case the Prym is the image of three elliptic curves whose restricted polarizations have type (2); the addition map has kernel {(0,0,0),(x1,x2,x3)} with every xi nonzero. Equivalently P=(E1 x E2 x E3)/<(x1,x2,x3)> with polarization type (1,2,2).

parent_05y.exact_use: The three character elliptic factors are j=1728 with End=Z[i], and the forced degrees are {137,9,9}.

05z_valid_parts_retained: the rational invariant/Prym split has 2-primary integral gluing
critical_05z_correction.reason: The 05Z witness T1=I+2M with M(e3)=e1 is an arbitrary Z/4-linear map. It is not the reduction of an R=Z[r], r^2=-2, linear endomorphism in M2(R). The active correspondence endomorphism is constrained to M2(R), so that witness is outside the allowed ring.
critical_05z_correction.replacement: Inside M2(R), every mod4 lift of a fixed retained mod2 residue induces the same action on A[2].

mod4_enumeration.decimal_encoding: little-endian bit i is parity of coordinate i
mod4_enumeration.exact_D4D4_coset_replay: A bounded D4+D4 reachability convolution proves that every one of these 128 classes per residue contains at least one integral vector of exact Q=602.

actual_R_linear_A2_action.A2_model: {x in J[4]:2x in W}/W with basis classes of 2e1,2e2,r*e1,r*e2
actual_R_linear_A2_action.R_linear_matrix_formula: For t_ij=a_ij+b_ij*r, use columns on (e1,e2,r e1,r e2); r multiplication sends r e_j to -2 e_j.

prym_glue_reduction.Presentation: P=(E1 x E2 x E3)/K, K=<k>, k=(x1,x2,x3), each xi nonzero in Ei[2]
prym_glue_reduction.gaussian_mod2: Z[i]/2 = F2[epsilon]/(epsilon^2); multiplication by i swaps two nonzero 2-torsion points and fixes the unique third nonzero point.
prym_glue_reduction.kernel_preservation: A product Gaussian endomorphism descends through K only if it fixes k. Thus an i-type component is allowed exactly when the selected xi is the unique CM-fixed nonzero 2-torsion point on that factor; identity-type components are always allowed.
prym_glue_reduction.polarization_kernel_model: Since the product restricted polarization is type (2,2,2) and K has order two, K(P,Ξ) is the four-dimensional symplectic quotient K^perp/K inside E1[2] direct-sum E2[2] direct-sum E3[2].

finite_F2_replay.if_no_selected_xi_is_CM_fixed: Only identity-type Gaussian actions preserve K, hence the Prym polarization-kernel action is identity.
finite_F2_replay.if_at_least_one_selected_xi_is_CM_fixed: Choosing i-type on one such factor and identity-type on the others gives a rank-one unipotent/transvection action on K(P,Ξ).
finite_F2_replay.consequence: The invariant-side transvection can only be glue-compatible if at least one of the three selected xi belongs to the CM-fixed 2-torsion orbit; at conjugacy-class level that condition is also sufficient to realize a Prym-side transvection.

decision.exact_blocker: The current package identifies the three j=1728 elliptic Prym factors but not the three specific nonzero kernel points xi relative to the Gaussian-CM fixed/swapped 2-torsion orbits. Without that identification, the Prym kernel action may be identity or may realize the same transvection conjugacy class as the invariant A[2] action.
decision.reopen_condition: Source-lock the three selected xi from the explicit X(8) quotient/addition geometry or an equivalent period/divisor adapter.

next_route.selection_reason: 05AA proves mod4 itself carries no further residue information in the actual R-linear endomorphism ring. The only remaining 2-primary distinction visible in the explicit isotropic Prym presentation is whether the three nonzero kernel points xi lie in the Gaussian-CM fixed or swapped 2-torsion orbits.
